To start modelsim:
> source /CMC/scripts/siemens.questasim.2022.1_2.csh <br>
> vsim -64 <br>


  * Make two projects in modelsim, one for rtl simulations and one for pnr simulations, with different testbench names to avoid any compilation mismatches in the /WORK directory of modelsim.
  
  * mkMACBuff.vcd will be generated by the runSim_pnr.tcl during simulation.
